doc: Boot phase: hoisted shared state, capture reset, and startup-placeholder handling.
Boot phase: the video area and label, and the splash-to-label clock handoff.
Boot phase: settings frame, scroll canvas, fonts, mouse-wheel scrolling and activity tracking.
Boot phase: the settings Location section (selector, rename, delete).
Boot phase: device state, the Devices section, the Updates flow, and the Content section.
Boot phase: render / display state, View 1 layout helpers, clock-saver and idle-dim state.
Boot phase: overlay widgets (clock, TMDb logo, status bar, playback overlay, circles, main settings) and splash warm-up.
Boot phase: blit caches and the stage / poster / now-playing render pipeline.
Boot phase: the command bar and the TMDb lookup / match-quality flow.
Boot phase: device list parsing, pairing LEDs, locations, and mid-bootstrap View 1 warm-up.
Boot phase: settings footer, saved-device seeding, and the device / playback polls.
Boot phase: mouse and keyboard bindings (Tab, Return, Space, view keys, hotkeys, chords).
Boot phase: receiver volume worker, GPIO / rotary / serial inputs, and settings navigation.
Boot phase: first render, receiver polls, and the bootstrap-done handoff to the splash.
